answer: Proof of Burn acts as a karst of capital, eroding the incentive for Sybil attacks by requiring agents to permanently destroy native tokens to gain consensus weight. Like a shifting dune that reshapes the network topology, this mechanism ensures that identity creation is a one-way voyage into economic sacrifice. Attackers face an insurmountable cost, as each fraudulent node necessitates a direct, irreversible drain on their own liquid assets to achieve validation influence.
